g.text: Pickup diagnosis from recorded native states
One posterior diagnostic per configuration. Home, initial and lift targets move +30 mm; CPU/CUDA also differs.
100 Hz contact observations and 25 Hz geometry checks do not certify continuous collision freedom or the full workflow.
